name: Sun Orchid Harvester
body:
Drawbacks
Sun Orchid Harvester
Source Dragonslayer's Handbook pg. 12
Category Region
Requirement(s) Thuvia
You were employed briefly by Deyrubrujuan’s alchemist cabal to harvest sun orchids deep in the Thuvian desert. Though you never worked your way deeper into the cabal, you retain the knowledge gained during your employment. You gain a +1 bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks made in desert environments.
